site.social.hero.lead.text: Off The Cloud is free, open-source software that gives your family a social network of its own. site.social.start.accounts.text: Add the family. In Settings › Users, in the web app or the phone apps, add an account for each person with Request bridge access on, and choose a first password to give them. They change it in Settings › Change Password, and from then on only they know it.
site.social.start.accounts.note: Website, the page comparing Off The Cloud's private social network with Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, FamilyAlbum and Pixelfed (off-the.cloud/private-social-network): section "Bringing your family in": the second step. <b> marks its short title in bold; <em> marks the name of the switch in the apps (a checkbox in the web app). Settings › Users and Request bridge access are names in the apps: use the apps' own words (web.settings, app.settings).

site.social.start.device.text: Set up the device. The computer app prepares the Raspberry Pi 5's card, and you finish the setup from your phone over Bluetooth, in about 20 minutes. It asks for a bridge account, which gives your device its off-the.cloud address.
site.social.start.device.note: Website, the page comparing Off The Cloud's private social network with Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, FamilyAlbum and Pixelfed (off-the.cloud/private-social-network): section "Bringing your family in": the first step. <b> marks its short title in bold. The bridge: our relay service. off-the.cloud is our domain: keep it as it is.

site.social.start.friends.text: Add friends. In Friends, type the name of a friend's device, such as casa for casa.off-the.cloud, and send the request. Once they accept, your posts appear in each other's feed.
site.social.start.friends.note: Website, the page comparing Off The Cloud's private social network with Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, FamilyAlbum and Pixelfed (off-the.cloud/private-social-network): section "Bringing your family in": the third step. <b> marks its short title in bold. Friends is the name of the app's section: use the app's own word (web.shell). casa and casa.off-the.cloud are an example: keep them as they are.

site.social.start.links.text: Share with everyone else. Choose photos in Images, add them to a collection and share it as a link.
site.social.start.links.note: Website, the page comparing Off The Cloud's private social network with Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, FamilyAlbum and Pixelfed (off-the.cloud/private-social-network): section "Bringing your family in": the last step. <b> marks its short title in bold. Images is the name of the app's section with the photos: use the app's own word (web.shell). A collection: a set of photos chosen in the app.
